content: वयुनम् [वय् उनन् <ls>Uṇ. 3. 60</ls>] (also used in adjectival sense) .²1 Knowledge, wisdom, faculty of perception; सर्वानाचष्ट वैकुण्ठं चक्षुषा वयुनेन सः <ls>Bhāg. 10. 13. 38</ls>, <ls n="Bhāg.">4. 9. 8</ls>. .²2 A temple (said to be {%m.%} also in this sense in Uṇadisūtras). .²3 A rule, precept, order. .²4 Manner, custom. .²5 Clearness. .²6 Action, act (कर्म); अग्ने नय सुपथा राये अस्मान् विश्वानि देव वयुनानि विद्वान् <ls>Īśop. 18</ls>.
